thread:
maria: Heads-up — since the cert rotator push in ap-southeast, we've seen a spike in TLS handshake failures in eu-west for inter-service calls. Mostly SNI mismatch + session ticket rejects.
kevin: Details? error rates / logs?
maria: 5234567890 root trace: envoy reports TLSv1.3 handshake: 'ticket key not found' and openssl shows 'SSL: error in SSL library, error:140A90B8:SSL routines:ssl3_get_client_certificate:wrong version number' for ~0.8% of requests between services A->B during peak.
anita: Could be ticket key namespace drift after rotator wrote new keys to KMS in ap-southeast only. Are we encrypting ticket keys with regional KMS?
ops-rotator: We rotated ticket encryption keys and rolled out changes. We intended to use per-region KMS key aliasing but a bad IAM policy meant eu-west rotator instances couldn't unwrap the latest key.
jake: That matches — logs show KMS:AccessDenied for service-account:rotator-eu on key alias "rotator-ticket-key-2026-03".
sre-oncall: Impact: short-lived 0.8% errors but bursts -> retransmits + higher latency. No user-facing errors yet but higher tail latency.
sec-bot: Vulnerability triage: CVE risk low (not protocol crypto vuln) but operational risk: ticket key unavailability can cause downgrade to full handshake and replay issues. Need containment.
maria: Immediate mitigation options: disable session tickets for cross-region connections temporarily, fallback to stateless session resumption, or roll forward with proper IAM. Thoughts?
kevin: Quick win — disable session tickets on envoy cluster level for affected routes (ap-southeast <-> eu-west). Example config snippet: ```tls_context: { tls_parameters: { tls_max_version: TLSv1_3 }, session_ticket_keys: [] }``` This forces full handshakes but avoids ticket lookups.
anita: We should also add KMS cross-region decrypt permission for rotator and a canary that verifies unwrap on boot. IAM patch: allow kms:Decrypt on alias/rotator-ticket-key-* for rotator-eu service account and rotator-eu instance role.
jake: Also need to audit logs: our audit pipeline currently drops KMS unwrap events for cross-region keys. We should enable audit forwarding for CloudKMS/HashiCorp unwrap events to central logging (sec-audit) with keystore_id tags.
ops-rotator: Proposed rollout plan: 1) grant temporary kms:Decrypt to rotator-eu 2) push canary that unwraps key at startup and fails fast 3) re-enable session tickets cluster-by-cluster 4) rotate ticket keys to new alias scoped per-region and replicate.
sre-oncall: Can we do a config-level canary? e.g., envoy config: ```tls_context: { session_ticket_keys: [{ inline_bytes: "<base64 old key>" }] }``` to test single instance.
maria: Good. Also add telemetry: augment TLS handshake logs with field ticket_key_id and kms_unwrap_result so we can filter quickly.
kevin: For long-term: store ticket encryption keys in HSM-backed KMS + use signed key metadata synced via control plane rather than per-instance discovery. Also RBAC: least-priv policy that allows decrypt for specific alias only with conditions on requestor region attribute.
anita: Action items: - @ops-rotator grant kms:Decrypt to rotator-eu (ETA 30m) - @kevin push envoy disable-session-tickets for eu-west ingress (ETA 20m) - @maria add audit-forward rule for kms:Decrypt events to sec-audit (ETA 1h) - @jake prepare IAM policy snippet + backout (ETA 45m)
ops-rotator: Doing step 1 now. Will post logs when done.
sec-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-5234567890 (tag: mtls-session-ticket-eviction).
maria: After ops confirms, we'll re-enable tickets only after canary pass for 5 minutes of sustained success.
kevin: Also recommend tuning TLS: set tls_min_version = TLSv1_3 and enforce AEAD ciphers only. Add config snippet to PR.
anita: And let's add an RBAC audit: list principals with kms:Decrypt across all key aliases and catch wildcard grants. I'll run and post results.
jake: I'll prep a followup thread with the exact IAM JSON and the envoy config diff.
sre-oncall: If anyone sees >1% error rate after the fix, escalate to P1.
maria: Thanks team. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and postmortem checklist once stabilized.
kevin: TL;DR: root cause = rotator IAM gap for cross-region KMS unwrap -> session ticket key unavailability -> handshake falls back -> tail latency. Mitigation = temp disable tickets + fix IAM + canary unwrap + re-enable.
anita: Closing loop: also add automated test in CI that simulates KMS unwrap deny and ensures envoy falls back gracefully (no crash, metrics present).
ops-rotator: Patch applied, rotator-eu can now decrypt. KMS logs show successful Unwrap by rotator-eu at 5234568030.
maria: Re-enabling session tickets on one canary pod now. Will monitor 5m.
sec-bot: 5234568100 monitor alert: handshake_fail_rate reduced from 0.8% -> 0.04% for canary cluster.
maria: Canary looks clean. Rolling to rest of eu-west clusters.
jake: I'll open PR with IAM changes + audit rule + envoy config (link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/998).
anita: Great. Postmortem reminders: include why alias replication didn't happen, add synthetic check for ticket unwrap per-region, and document RBAC for rotators.
kevin: Marking followups in backlog: INFRA-rotator-kms-rbac, SRE-mtls-audit, SECURITY-ticketkey-rotation.
maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
